description: Commerce software and payments for merchants: online storefronts, physical retail, payment processing, shipping, and merchant financing.

catalyst.facts_line: 2026-11-03 (Tuesday, before the open), 44 days out -- from the earnings calendar, consensus EPS 0.46.
catalyst.why: Must show merchant solutions revenue and holiday GMV still growing above 30% without AI spending compressing margins.

reasons: Because Shopify earned 43% of 2025 operating income in the fourth quarter, Deloitte's 7.5%-8.4% US holiday e-commerce growth forecast leads straight into merchant solutions revenue in the quarter that decides the year.

The SMB [small and medium business] squeeze flagged for Q4 2026 has not reached the reported figures because AI marketing use jumped to 73% from 41%: revenue rose 13% and EBIT [earnings before interest and tax] 180% quarter-over-quarter.

Analysts raised FY [full year] estimates 29 times against 6 cuts in 30 days, so if the 2026-11-03 print confirms that pace, the AI-cost margin fear behind the 25% drawdown breaks and revisions pull the price up.

quants.eps_trend: slightly up over the last 7 days
quants.eps_revisions: tilted higher, with 29 up and 6 down over last 30 days

structuring.thesis_target: Targets the 2026-11-03 report, with the long leg expiring 2026-11-20, which gives the thesis time to show up.
structuring.reflection: The near call expires 18 days before the long one, so the credit is collected into the 2026-11-03 print while the long leg carries the event -- but a move above 135 before 16 October turns the short leg against us. At 16.2% conservative credit against a 10% floor the cushion is thin; the trade needs the stock to stay under 135 into mid-October and then break it.
